description: Image Description: The image depicts a scenic mountain landscape with two horses on a paved road. The road curves gently through the scene, bordered by lush green grass. One horse is walking along the road, while the other grazes on the grass to the right. In the background, there are dramatic, jagged mountains capped with snow under a partly cloudy sky. The lighting is vibrant, giving the scene a slightly surreal and high-contrast appearance.
